more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Glycerol is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec, table-top sweeteners in liquid form. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for reported food-use exposure in 2017.
Young children could reach therapeutic-dose exposure through large beverage servings, and potentially harmful manufacturing residues require control.
